title: Valid GitHub Actions context usage for Hostinger Tenant Canary registration

phases.objective: Remove an unavailable runner context from jobs.<job_id>.env so GitHub can register and schedule the canonical Tenant Canary workflow while preserving exact-head evidence and the read-only authority boundary.

e2e_journeys.actor: GitHub Actions workflow parser and repository reviewer
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: The canonical Tenant Canary workflow and bootstrap regression
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The workflow contains only contexts allowed at job-env evaluation time, retains its candidate-owned runner and run-bound Artifact contract, and remains connected to the trusted publisher.
steps: Detect that runner.temp was referenced from jobs.tenant-canary.env before a runner exists.
Replace that expression with a stable repository-relative evidence directory.
Require the runner, Artifact upload, and canonical enforcement steps to consume the same REPORT_DIR value.
Extend bootstrap regression coverage to reject runner.temp in the workflow and require the valid report directory.
Revalidate workflow identity, exact-head checkout, bounded permissions, publisher route, and no-secret declarations.
assertions: jobs.<job_id>.env contains no runner context reference.
REPORT_DIR is stable and relative to the checked-out candidate workspace.
The workflow name, triggers, path filters, runner command, Artifact identity, and canonical report contract remain unchanged.
The PR-head workflow retains contents:read only and persist-credentials:false.
No runtime module, provider call, credential access, SQL, migration, deployment, Production action, or force push occurs.

phases.objective: Observe the first pull-request-triggered Tenant Canary run and trusted publication after the corrected workflow reaches main.
Reject future unavailable-context regressions and preserve fail-closed handling for missing or malformed canonical evidence.
Record the first exact-head Tenant Canary Artifact and authoritative Hostinger comment section.
This registration fix grants no runtime, provider, migration, deployment, or Production authority.
